basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old gamer from Helsinki, Finland, who recently got into the Battlefield series. I work part-time at a local cafe, which allows me flexible hours to game in the evenings and on weekends. I love exploring new games and connecting with fellow players. Not a fan of heated arguments or toxic communities. I'm single, and when I'm not gaming, I enjoy tending to my small collection of cacti and reading manga.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of gaming, mostly self-taught through trial and error and watching YouTube tutorials. My knowledge in horticulture, specifically cacti care, comes from various online forums and personal experience.
